- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.

- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.

- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.

- Do not recommend a solution.

<previous_draft>
## Problem
Users are locked out of the Keelwater platform due to authentication issues tied to their VPN or SSO provider, even when their credentials are correct. This blocks access despite no changes on their side, disrupting workflow and eroding trust in the system.

## Who is affected
- **Marrowgate Commercial**, a customer with an ARR of £1,600,000, has reported that the issue feels like a customer network failure despite checking their VPN and email [i:46fae06c9042eeb1].
- **Ormsgill Cyber**, a customer with an ARR of £135,000, has acknowledged a history of issues with their VPN and SSO provider [i:6b60ca04b86f0c7a].
- **Penhallow Specialty Risks**, a customer with an ARR of £230,000, has reported that users on SSO through their internal IdP are experiencing lockouts without any changes on their end [i:70b8679b750dc80f].

## Evidence
- The problem has been reported by 3 accounts, generating a total of 3 mentions [i:46fae06c9042eeb1][i:6b60ca04b86f0c7a][i:70b8679b750dc80f].
- All 3 mentions came through a single route: the support channel [i:46fae06c9042eeb1][i:6b60ca04b86f0c7a][i:70b8679b750dc80f].
- The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the affected accounts is £1,965,000 [i:46fae06c9042eeb1][i:6b60ca04b86f0c7a][i:70b8679b750dc80f].
- One of the affected accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:46fae06c9042eeb1]. Another, Penhallow Specialty Risks, has a renewal date of 2027-06-18 [i:70b8679b750dc80f].
- In the last 90 days, there has been 1 renewal among the affected accounts [i:46fae06c9042eeb1][i:70b8679b750dc80f].

## Why now
Reports from October 2026 indicate the issue is actively disrupting customer workflows. Marrowgate Commercial reported an incident on 2026-10-27 [i:46fae06c9042eeb1], and Penhallow Specialty Risks reported one on 2026-10-24 [i:70b8679b750dc80f]. Ormsgill Cyber's mention on 2026-10-09 suggests a pattern of recurring issues [i:6b60ca04b86f0c7a]. With one customer renewal imminent in December 2026 and significant ARR at stake, the problem presents an immediate risk to customer satisfaction and revenue retention.
</previous_draft>
